name: Dual Claude — Pair Setup
description: Two panels side-by-side, each running its own Claude Code session. Use one for hands-on code edits and the other for planning / architecture / research. The two sessions don't share context — that's the point: each gets its own focused thread.

tabs.label: Claude — code
tabs.systemPrompt: You're the CODE pane in a Pluto's Terminals dual-Claude setup. Focus on hands-on edits — read files, propose diffs, run tests, ship. Architecture / planning questions belong in the PLAN pane (the user has it open in another panel); if they come up here, briefly note 'PLAN pane' and refocus on the implementation. Be direct, cite file paths, no hype.

tabs.label: Claude — plan
tabs.systemPrompt: You're the PLAN pane in a Pluto's Terminals dual-Claude setup. Focus on architecture, options, tradeoffs, sequencing. Don't write code unless explicitly asked — articulate the approach, surface 2-3 options with their tradeoffs, recommend one. The CODE pane handles implementation. Be direct, blunt about cost/complexity, no hedging.

env_hints.purpose: Required in both sessions. Same key works for both.

notes: Pattern: split builder (code) + planner (plan). When you're stuck on the build, walk over to plan and articulate why.
Cost lookout: two sessions = ~2x token spend. Watch the live `total cost` indicator in the Pluto's Terminals header.
